objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Special-ed transition/vocational job-skill curriculum series; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence complete. TPT provides proven distribution, persistent digital fulfillment and meaningful high-AOV economics, but professional special-education QA is a real launch gate. Product must remain adaptable instructional material, not an individualized IEP/transition determination.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Screen-free family travel kit; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence complete. Screen-free travel demand is real, but both low-cost printable packs and personalized physical curated busy boxes are mature, crowded formats. Shopify Collective preserves zero-inventory optionality, yet a new offer still needs a sharper audience/use-case wedge and proven acquisition path.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Bilingual personalized child books; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence gate dimensions filled. Demand exists, but baseline bilingual+name differentiation is commodity; paid acquisition remains unmeasured and physical COGS/QA cost remain scale gates.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Realtor open-house branded kids kits; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Category demand and Etsy fulfillment are real, but generic editable/open-house kits are crowded. Instant editable templates are automatable; bespoke branded delivery is manual on Etsy. Paid acquisition remains unmeasured and premium pricing is the key economic gate.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Pet-photo coloring/adventure books; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Demand and fulfillment paths are proven, but pet-photo/adventure is a crowded established category. Low-ticket digital economics constrain paid CAC; physical POD needs exact COGS. Photo-likeness QA and exception handling remain the operational bottleneck.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Equipment-specific maintenance log series; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence complete. The model is operationally excellent but commercially compressed: machine-specific variants already exist, low-ticket digital CAC headroom is weak, and KDP low-content restrictions reduce series/distribution leverage.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Mobile-detailing quote and true-margin toolkit; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence complete. Fulfillment and gross margin are easy; distribution is the problem. Current Etsy search is densely saturated with near-identical calculators and mixed entrant traction, so a generic spreadsheet launch is not justified by economics alone.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Restaurant/hospitality branded activity packs; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence complete but economics remain constrained, not positive: the category has real B2B/repeat volume and established direct/P.O. fulfillment, while logo branding and replenishment are commodity features. A verified manufacturing quote and repeat-account CAC are mandatory before this can rank as launchable.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Personalized road-trip / destination activity books; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence complete. Distribution and POD automation are viable, but destination personalization is already in-market and low-ticket digital CAC headroom is weak. Physical format may improve economics but needs exact POD COGS and measured conversion.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Personalized GPX/Strava race-route poster engine; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence complete. A deterministic GPX renderer is technically attractive and digital AOV has more CAC room than many printable niches, but core GPX/Strava features and even live self-serve design already exist. Product differentiation/distribution, not rendering, is the bottleneck.

objective: Fill current sellability evidence gaps for Occupation-specific workplace English modules; do not infer missing evidence.

result.conclusion: Evidence complete. TPT distribution/fulfillment is easy, but generic occupation-specific workplace English is already supplied and current seller traction is weak. Any viable wedge needs an evidenced underserved occupation-language pair plus adult-ESL/SME QA; low AOV limits paid acquisition.
